purpose: Teach: 棺/鱗/葡萄/シルクロード/ラベンダー/眼科/苗字/ピストル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお葬式で棺を見送ったわね
lines.en: Sho, you said goodbye to Grandpa at the funeral, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, steady acknowledgment. Soft opening. The tone of someone recognizing a moment her son lived through, not questioning it. Warm presence holding space.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがお魚の鱗を取って下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa helped me clean the fish scales off.
lines.style: Bright recall, but grounded. Not performing—genuinely lighting up at the memory. Small voice. The simple pride of having done something with someone he loved.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママが葡萄ジュース作って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma said she'd make you grape juice.
lines.style: Soft, passing kindness along. Not excited herself—observing his world. Offering this small comfort without making it dramatic. The quiet way mothers mark the good things people do.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとシルクロードの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read the Silk Road book together.
lines.style: Eager to share. Voice lifting slightly. Not urgent—genuine delight in the detail. Testing if she cares about the things he cares about. Small, genuine laugh lives in this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラベンダーのアロマを買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad brought home some lavender oil.
lines.style: Continuing to weave his world together for him. Matter-of-fact delivery, but the care underneath is audible. She's tracking the small things that fill his days. No urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、明日、眼科の検診に行くんだよね
lines.en: Mom, I have my eye exam tomorrow, right?
lines.style: Checking in, not anxious yet but preparing himself mentally. Quiet certainty in his voice. Looking for confirmation, reassurance through routine. Sho being Sho—practical and a little careful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの苗字、覚えやすいわね
lines.en: Sho, your father's surname is easy to remember, isn't it.
lines.style: A gentle, almost musing observation. Not quite a question. Like she's noticing something about continuity, identity. Warm, reflective. Speaking more to herself than at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、博物館で古いピストルを見て怖かったよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw an old gun at the museum and it scared me.
lines.style: Quiet disclosure of something that unsettled him. Not dramatic, not seeking comfort loudly—just telling her. Voice smaller here. Trusting her to understand without explanation. Sho being vulnerable in his careful way.
